title: An involution on Dyck paths in the region $\defc\le\min(\area,\dinv)$ that interchanges area and dinv
summary: We construct an explicit involution on Dyck paths satisfying $\defc\le\min(\area,\dinv)$ that interchanges area and dinv, where $\defc=\binom n2-\area-\dinv$ and $n$ is the semilength. In addition, we give an involution on Dyck paths with $\defc \le 2n-8$ that interchanges area and dinv. Finally, we give an explicit partition formula for the portion of the $q,t$-Catalan polynomial of total degree at least $\binom n2-2n+8$, thereby proving a conjecture of Lee and Li~\cite[Conjecture~4]{LeeLi11}.
